verdicts.quote: joining authorizes automatic booking if a seat opens and existing rules allow it.
Order equal-time joins by their recorded acceptance sequence.
verdicts.missing: FIFO and its tie-breaker are specified. Whether membership tiers or staff can override that order remains open.

verdicts.quote: if promotion takes effect first, any subsequent cancellation follows the existing booking rules.
verdicts.missing: The rule covers canceling a confirmed booking. It leaves unstated whether declining or missing a promotion itself incurs a late-cancellation or no-show penalty.

verdicts.quote: A vacancy enters fulfillment when existing booking rules make it bookable, including a cancellation that makes a seat bookable. Accepted waitlist work remains eligible for fulfillment with all clients closed.
verdicts.missing: The trigger and background behavior are specified. The maximum time to complete promotion after the seat becomes bookable is open.

verdicts.quote: A completed promotion appears on the existing booking surface upon authoritative refresh.
verdicts.missing: The specification describes status on refresh and defers to existing notification obligations. It supplies no promotion notification channel, message content, or handling for failed delivery.

verdicts.quote: With openings and eligible entries, allocate up to the smaller of the two counts, rechecking at each commit.

Duplicate or stale work cannot create a second booking, move a different entry, or displace a committed booking. | At the last seat, a valid waiting entry takes priority over a competing direct booking.
If interactive confirmation, charging, or another irreversible user action is required, the product owner must decide how to allocate the seat in that flow before planning dependent fulfillment.
verdicts.missing: When to charge for a promoted booking and what happens to the seat and entry if payment fails.

verdicts.quote: When a required limit prevents a join, show that the waitlist cannot accept the request and keep all existing entries in their prior order.
verdicts.missing: Whether a cap applies, its scope, and the maximum number of active entries.

verdicts.quote: Fulfillment runs inside the existing permitted booking window. At its effective closing boundary use the existing authority's definition of open; once closed, no promotion can commit.
verdicts.missing: When that window closes relative to class start, including whether it closes before the class starts.

verdicts.quote: A cancellation or capacity change that creates zero bookable seats yields zero promotions.
When the instance ceases to support bookings permanently, end active participation. Show the applicable closed/canceled state to viewers who are still authorized.
Keep only existing identity/class references, acceptance order, and the disposition data necessary to reconcile the operation.
verdicts.missing: The record retains acceptance order and disposition without a separate position field. It is unclear whether it also records the join timestamp.

verdicts.quote: When that policy permits removal and reconciliation no longer needs the waitlist record, remove it from persistent feature data and derived views.
verdicts.missing: Permanent closure ends active participation, but the retention period for ended entries after the class runs is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: The default waitlist view shows only own status, with no roster or numeric position.
verdicts.missing: Other members' identities are hidden. The specified view omits the member's own queue position.

verdicts.quote: Active waiting state belongs to the booking authority, survives client closure, and is disclosed to the booker for that entry and existing authorized service roles as required to administer booking.
verdicts.missing: Which staff can view the queue, manually promote or remove someone, and inspect a history showing who was promoted and when.

verdicts.quote: The runtime owner must establish how the existing authority can complete/recover this work without an open client, including its deadline and workload limits.
verdicts.missing: The maximum elapsed time from a seat-releasing cancellation to a confirmed promotion.

verdicts.quote: On a reset of `G18` with no joins, `E` cancels and `D` uses ordinary booking. R-2.a permits direct booking with no eligible entry; recomputed bookings `{A,D}`, queue `[]`.
An eligible booker viewing a full, bookable class instance sees a Join waitlist action
verdicts.missing: The rule applies to a full class viewed in the app. It leaves activation and initial waitlist state for classes already full at rollout unspecified.
